WITH pubs AS (
  SELECT
    "publication_date" AS publication_date,
    "country_code" AS country_code,
    "publication_number" AS publication_number,
    "family_id" AS family_id,
    "inventor" AS inventor
  FROM PATENTS.PATENTS.PUBLICATIONS
  WHERE "country_code" = 'CA'
    AND "publication_date" IS NOT NULL
    AND TRY_TO_NUMBER("publication_date") IS NOT NULL
    -- restrict range to 1960-2024 to allow grouping up to 2020 (publication_date stored as YYYYMMDD or YYYY)
    AND (("publication_date" >= 19600000 AND "publication_date" <= 20209999)
         OR ("publication_date" >= 1960 AND "publication_date" <= 2020))
),
pubs_parsed AS (
  SELECT
    publication_number,
    family_id,
    country_code,
    -- normalize publication_date to a year integer
    CASE
      WHEN publication_date > 10000 THEN FLOOR(publication_date / 10000)  -- YYYYMMDD -> YYYY
      ELSE publication_date
    END AS pub_year,
    inventor
  FROM pubs
),
inventor_counts AS (
  SELECT
    publication_number,
    family_id,
    country_code,
    pub_year,
    -- count inventors: if inventor is ARRAY-like VARIANT, count elements; if null -> 0; if scalar -> 1
    CASE
      WHEN inventor IS NULL THEN 0
      WHEN (typeof(inventor) = 'array') THEN array_size(inventor)
      ELSE 1
    END AS inventor_count
  FROM pubs_parsed
),
filtered AS (
  -- only include publications with at least one inventor and years between 1960 and 2020
  SELECT *
  FROM inventor_counts
  WHERE inventor_count >= 1
    AND pub_year BETWEEN 1960 AND 2020
),
buckets AS (
  SELECT
    -- compute 5-year bucket start year: e.g. 1960-1964 => 1960
    FLOOR((pub_year - 1960) / 5) * 5 + 1960 AS bucket_start,
    pub_year,
    inventor_count,
    publication_number
  FROM filtered
)
SELECT
  TO_CHAR(bucket_start) || '-' || TO_CHAR(bucket_start + 4) AS five_year_period,
  -- average number of inventors per publication in the bucket
  ROUND(AVG(inventor_count)::NUMBER, 2) AS avg_inventors_per_publication,
  COUNT(DISTINCT publication_number) AS total_canadian_publications
FROM buckets
GROUP BY bucket_start
ORDER BY bucket_start

  FROM PATENTS.PATENTS.PUBLICATIONS

abstract_texts AS (
  SELECT
    publication_number,
    publication_date,
    filing_date,
    country_code,
    -- extract all text values from abstract_localized variant (could be object/array); coalesce to single string
    CASE
      WHEN abstract_localized IS NULL THEN ''
      WHEN TYPEOF(abstract_localized) = 'OBJECT' THEN 
        ARRAY_TO_STRING(
          ARRAY_AGG(value::string) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY key),
          ' '
        )
      WHEN TYPEOF(abstract_localized) = 'ARRAY' THEN
        ARRAY_TO_STRING(

          ' '
        )

    END AS abstract_text

  LATERAL (
    SELECT *
    FROM TABLE(
      GENERATOR(ROWCOUNT => 1)
    )
  ),
  LATERAL (
    -- normalize variant into rows of key/value when object, or index/value when array, else single value
    SELECT key, value, index FROM (
      SELECT
        CASE WHEN TYPEOF(abstract_localized) = 'OBJECT' THEN
          (SELECT KEY FROM LATERAL FLATTEN(input => abstract_localized) LIMIT 1)
        ELSE NULL END AS key,
        CASE WHEN TYPEOF(abstract_localized) = 'OBJECT' THEN
          (SELECT VALUE FROM LATERAL FLATTEN(input => abstract_localized) LIMIT 1)
        ELSE NULL END AS value,
        CASE WHEN TYPEOF(abstract_localized) = 'ARRAY' THEN
          (SELECT VALUE FROM LATERAL FLATTEN(input => abstract_localized) LIMIT 1)
        ELSE NULL END AS value,
        CASE WHEN TYPEOF(abstract_localized) = 'ARRAY' THEN
          (SELECT INDEX FROM LATERAL FLATTEN(input => abstract_localized) LIMIT 1)
        ELSE NULL END AS index
    )
  )
),
-- The above attempt to flatten in a single step can be simplified: produce normalized text by handling common shapes more directly
normalized_abstracts AS (
  SELECT
    publication_number,
    publication_date,
    filing_date,
    country_code,
    -- simpler normalization: if object, concat all string values; if array, concat elements; else use string cast
    CASE
      WHEN abstract_localized IS NULL THEN ''
      WHEN TYPEOF(abstract_localized) = 'OBJECT' THEN
        (SELECT ARRAY_TO_STRING(ARRAY_AGG(value::string) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY key), ' ')
         FROM LATERAL FLATTEN(input => abstract_localized) f(key, value))
      WHEN TYPEOF(abstract_localized) = 'ARRAY' THEN
        (SELECT ARRAY_TO_STRING(ARRAY_AGG(value::string) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY index), ' ')
         FROM LATERAL FLATTEN(input => abstract_localized) f(index, value))
      ELSE abstract_localized::string
    END AS abstract_text
  FROM pubs
),
filtered_us_iot AS (
  SELECT
    publication_number,
    publication_date,
    filing_date,
    country_code,

months AS (

WITH
-- base publications with aliases
pub AS (
  SELECT
    "publication_number" AS publication_number,
    "application_number" AS application_number,
    "family_id" AS family_id,
    "publication_date" AS publication_date,
    "filing_date" AS filing_date,
    "grant_date" AS grant_date,
    "kind_code" AS kind_code
  FROM PATENTS.PATENTS.PUBLICATIONS
),
-- select utility patents granted in 2010: assume kind_code indicating grant (e.g., 'B' or starts with 'B') and grant_date in 2010
utility_grants_2010 AS (
  SELECT
    publication_number,
    application_number,
    family_id,
    filing_date,
    grant_date
  FROM pub
  WHERE grant_date IS NOT NULL
    AND TO_VARCHAR(TO_DATE(TO_CHAR(grant_date), 'YYYYMMDD')) IS NOT NULL
    AND TO_NUMBER(TO_CHAR(grant_date), '99999999') BETWEEN 20100101 AND 20101231
    AND (kind_code IS NOT NULL AND UPPER(kind_code) LIKE 'B%')
    AND filing_date IS NOT NULL
),
-- all publications to be considered as potential citers with their application dates
all_pubs AS (
  SELECT
    publication_number AS citer_publication_number,
    application_number AS citer_application_number,
    filing_date AS citer_filing_date,
    publication_date AS citer_publication_date
  FROM pub
  WHERE application_number IS NOT NULL
),
-- extract citations: from CPC_DEFINITION is not relevant; assume citation data lives in PUBLICATIONS.citation VARIANT.
-- Flatten citations from the cited patent side: each publication has a "citation" VARIANT listing citations it makes.
-- We need citing application numbers that cite our target patents. So we flatten citation lists from all_pubs (as citer) and capture cited publication/application numbers.
flattened_citations AS (
  SELECT
    a.citer_application_number,
    a.citer_filing_date,
    c.value:"publication_number"::VARCHAR AS cited_publication_number,
    c.value:"application_number"::VARCHAR AS cited_application_number,
    c.value:"date"::NUMBER AS citation_date
  FROM PATENTS.PATENTS.PUBLICATIONS AS base_pub
  , LATERAL (
    SELECT
      "publication_number" AS publication_number,
      "application_number" AS application_number,
      "filing_date" AS filing_date,
      "citation" AS citation
    FROM PATENTS.PATENTS.PUBLICATIONS
    WHERE "citation" IS NOT NULL
  ) a -- alias not used directly; instead join via base table above is required by quoting rules; to satisfy quoting rules we'll re-query properly
  JOIN LATERAL FLATTEN(input => base_pub."citation") c ON TRUE
  -- The above approach uses base_pub which is from the same table; to comply with quoting rules, select needed columns directly:
),
-- Because of strict quoting and the need to alias when selecting base columns, rebuild flattened citations correctly:
citers_with_citations AS (
  SELECT
    p_sel.citer_publication_number,
    p_sel.citer_application_number,
    p_sel.citer_filing_date,
    f.value:"publication_number"::VARCHAR AS cited_publication_number,
    f.value:"application_number"::VARCHAR AS cited_application_number,
    f.value:"date"::NUMBER AS citation_date
  FROM (
    SELECT
      "publication_number" AS citer_publication_number,
      "application_number" AS citer_application_number,
      "filing_date" AS citer_filing_date,
      "citation" AS citation
    FROM PATENTS.PATENTS.PUBLICATIONS
    WHERE "citation" IS NOT NULL
  ) p_sel,
  LATERAL FLATTEN(input => p_sel.citation) f
),
-- Now join citations to target patents and filter citations occurring within 10 years after target filing date.
citations_to_targets AS (
  SELECT
    t.publication_number AS target_publication_number,
    t.application_number AS target_application_number,
    t.filing_date AS target_filing_date,
    c.citer_application_number AS citer_application_number,
    c.citation_date AS citation_date
  FROM utility_grants_2010 t
  JOIN citers_with_citations c
    ON COALESCE(c.cited_publication_number, c.cited_application_number) = COALESCE(t.publication_number, t.application_number)
  WHERE c.citer_application_number IS NOT NULL
    -- compute 10 years window: filing_date + 10 years = add 10*10000 to YYYYMMDD numeric or use dates
    AND c.citation_date IS NOT NULL
    AND TO_DATE(TO_CHAR(c.citation_date), 'YYYYMMDD') BETWEEN TO_DATE(TO_CHAR(t.filing_date), 'YYYYMMDD')
                                                      AND DATEADD(year, 10, TO_DATE(TO_CHAR(t.filing_date), 'YYYYMMDD'))
),
-- count distinct citing application numbers per target within window
counts AS (
  SELECT
    target_publication_number,
    target_application_number,
    COUNT(DISTINCT citer_application_number) AS forward_citation_count
  FROM citations_to_targets
  GROUP BY target_publication_number, target_application_number
)
-- final: number of utility patents granted in 2010 with exactly one forward citation within 10 years
SELECT COUNT(*) AS patents_with_exactly_one_forward_citation
FROM (
  SELECT t.publication_number, t.application_number
  FROM utility_grants_2010 t
  LEFT JOIN counts c
    ON t.publication_number = c.target_publication_number
      AND t.application_number = c.target_application_number
  WHERE COALESCE(c.forward_citation_count, 0) = 1
) q

  -- normalize values: check for SEA in category (case-insensitive) and for backward direction (commonly 'backward' or 'citedBy' or 'backward citation')
  lower(category) = 'sea'
  AND lower(direction) IN ('backward','backward citation','citedby','cited_by','cited-by','cited by','cites','cited')
GROUP BY publication_number
ORDER BY publication_number

WITH pubs AS (
  SELECT
    "publication_number" AS publication_number,
    "family_id" AS family_id,
    "country_code" AS country_code,
    "kind_code" AS kind_code,
    "grant_date" AS grant_date,
    "claims_localized" AS claims_localized
  FROM PATENTS.PATENTS.PUBLICATIONS
  WHERE "country_code" = 'US'
    AND "kind_code" = 'B2'
    AND "grant_date" BETWEEN 20080000 AND 20181231
    AND "claims_localized" IS NOT NULL
),
claims_extracted AS (
  SELECT
    publication_number,
    grant_date,
    L.value::string AS claim_text
  FROM pubs,
  LATERAL FLATTEN(input => claims_localized) L
  -- claims_localized may be an array of localized objects; try to extract text fields
  WHERE L.value IS NOT NULL
),
claims_normalized AS (
  SELECT
    publication_number,
    grant_date,
    LOWER(TRIM(claim_text)) AS claim_text_lower
  FROM claims_extracted
),
pubs_with_claims AS (
  -- Determine for each publication whether ANY claim contains the word 'claim'
  SELECT
    publication_number,
    grant_date,
    MAX(CASE WHEN claim_text_lower LIKE '%claim%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS has_claim_word
  FROM claims_normalized
  GROUP BY publication_number, grant_date
)
SELECT
  COUNT(*) AS num_us_b2_granted_2008_2018_without_word_claim_in_claims
FROM pubs_with_claims
WHERE has_claim_word = 0
